title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Rule on Training Weeks Added to an Extended Benefits Entitlement
content:
For an Extended Benefits (EB) entitlement on Unemployment Benefit Claims, training weeks are added when the parent claim records enrolled approved training. The parent claim's age is the number of calendar days from its effective date to the handling date.

| Approved training on the parent claim | Parent claim's age | Training weeks added |
|---|---|---|
| Enrolled | At least 182 days | 2 (the long-claim training weeks) |
| Enrolled | Fewer than 182 days | 1 (the short-claim training weeks) |
| Not enrolled | Any | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Enrolled training, parent claim 182 days old: 2 weeks. At 181 days: 1 week.
- Approved training not enrolled on the parent claim, whatever its age: no training weeks.
